product_overview: A comprehensive educational platform focused on programming courses, enabling interactive learning, secure communication, and effective course management for students, teachers, and administrators.
core_goals: Provide a secure, user-friendly environment for learning programming via structured courses and interactive exercises.
Enable seamless and secure communication between students and teachers through real-time encrypted chat.
Support robust course management and content creation tools for teachers.
Offer administrative capabilities for managing users, courses, and system settings.
Implement gamification features like streaks and achievements to motivate continuous learning.
Include comprehensive user profile management and personalized settings.
Ensure high code execution reliability across multiple programming languages for practice and submissions.
key_features: User Authentication with JWT, OAuth (Google, GitHub, VK), and Two-Factor Authentication (2FA).
End-to-End Encrypted real-time chat system between students and teachers.
Student Dashboard displaying courses, challenges, solutions, ratings, chat access, and profile management.
Interactive Learning Platform with lessons, quizzes, practice exercises, and progress tracking.
Teacher Panel for managing courses, students, submissions, and real-time communication.
Administrative Panel for overseeing users, courses, and system configurations.
Multi-language Code Execution and linting service integrated into the platform.
Course Management capabilities including creation, editing, structuring, and enrollment management.
Submission system to handle code submissions with grading and feedback.
Gamification elements such as daily streaks, achievements, gems, and streak freezes to engage learners.
User Profile and Settings management with avatar uploads, theme preferences, notifications, and security settings.
File Uploads support for course materials and chat attachments.
Public marketing and informational pages including Home, About, Reviews, Corporate, Blog, and FAQ.
user_flow_summary: Users register or log in using email/password or OAuth providers, optionally setting up 2FA.
Students browse and enroll in courses, access lessons, quizzes, and submit code challenges.
Teachers create and edit course content, review student submissions, and engage via chat.
Real-time encrypted chat enables communication between students and teachers.
Admins manage user roles, courses, and platform settings through an administrative interface.
Students and teachers monitor progress and achievements on personalized dashboards.
Users customize their profiles and notification settings.
Code submissions are executed and validated with immediate feedback via the platform's runner service.
validation_criteria: Successful user authentication including OAuth and 2FA flows.
End-to-end encryption verified for chat messages with no data leaks.
Functional course enrollment, content access, and progress tracking for students.
Effective creation and editing of course material by teachers.
Real-time chat operational with message delivery and encryption.
Administrative controls reliably manage users and courses.
Code execution engine supports all targeted programming languages with correct output.
File uploads for chat and course materials work without data loss or corruption.
Gamification statistics and rewards accurately track user activity.
Users can update profiles, preferences, and settings persistently.
Website public pages display correct marketing content and FAQ entries.
